task.title: Repair canonical auto-integrator receipt reconciliation for registry repositories

owned: .orchestrator/multi_repo_registry.py repository scope validation and task_repository_slug_and_default_branch helper
.orchestrator/rewrite/integration_receipt.py frozen_delivery_binding multi-repo resolution and thread config
scripts/git/test_auto_integrator.py candidate consumption and execute-plans regression tests
not_changing: auto-integrator candidate selection or GitHub merge gate
task state store architecture or receipt store schema
second integrator, receipt store, cron, gate, status API, or direct merge path

root_cause_analysis.defect: The sole canonical auto-integrator merged execute-plans PR #747, but receipt reconciliation failed with 'delivery binding no longer matches the revalidated snapshot'.
root_cause_analysis.mechanism: scripts/git/auto_integrator.py passes the selected registry repository slug ('ajoe734/execute-plans') to rewrite.integration_receipt. However, frozen_delivery_binding in rewrite/integration_receipt.py hard-coded validation to target_repo in {'pantheon', 'ajoe734/pantheon'}, returning None for all non-Pantheon registry repositories. This caused _apply_receipt_to_state to detect a delivery binding mismatch and reject the receipt.
root_cause_analysis.repair: Extended frozen_delivery_binding and integration_receipt_consumes_candidate to resolve the repository slug and default branch via multi_repo_registry.task_repository_slug_and_default_branch using the configured registry. Preserved pure predicate contract (no filesystem I/O in candidate consumption) and fail-closed semantics for unknown or ambiguous repositories.
